title: Anthropic runner errors
description: The Anthropic runner's own error codes, beyond the runner contract's. They fill the contract's runnerErrors extension point. Each refuses run/start, so no request is sent.

oneOf.description: The run/start options hold a key the runner doesn't define, such as endpoint or model, which come from the run's runtime.
An option's value has the wrong shape. The fix names what is valid.
The run/start names no runtime, or one that names no model, so the runner has no service to talk to. The fix says what to give the runtime.

The runtime's endpoint can't be used as the Messages API's base URL: it ends in /v1 (the library adds /v1/messages itself), holds a query, a fragment or user info, or isn't an http or https URL with a host. The fix names the endpoint to use, never repeating one that holds user info.

run/start and the runner's environment disagree about the credential: run/start's runtime.credential is true and TROUPE_RUNTIME_CREDENTIAL isn't set, or it's false and the variable is set. The problem says which way, never the value.
The runtime has a credential and an http endpoint whose host isn't this machine, so the credential would travel in the clear.

The run's credential holds a character a request header can't carry: anything but visible ASCII, such as a line ending left from the file it was read from, or a letter outside ASCII. The problem names the variable, never the value.

where.description: Where the problem is, such as options.maxTurns or runtime.
